title: Portland Sailing Center
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Portland Sailing Center is a sailing school on the Columbia River near Portland Airport. Been here since the eighties, a lot of years to figure out what works the best for students. We teach sailing on ballasted keelboats from 22 to 39 feet in length. Most classes are local, one sails in the Gorge, one on the ocean.
